title: A job name that is too long is cut short without a word, and the test locks that in
what: When the owner types a staff job longer than 40 letters, the admin app quietly cuts it to 40 and saves that. The test of the job box checks that a long job is cut, which is the opposite of the journey. The gym server would refuse it with a message, but the app never sends it the long text.
expected: The owner is told the job is too long and nothing is saved, or the box shows how many letters are left so nothing is cut by surprise.
how_often: rare: only a job over 40 letters
fix_line: Show a letters-left count or a too-long message instead of cutting silently, and change the test to match

title: Nothing tests that a friend invite at a paused gym rings nobody
what: The tests of Bring a friend cover new numbers, known enquiries, members, the member's own number and the daily cap, but never a gym that MettleUp has paused. A change could let a paused gym still get friend alerts and notes, and no test would fail.
expected: A test sends a friend invite to a paused gym and checks that no alert, note or enquiry is made.
fix_line: Add a paused-gym case to the friend invite test

title: Nothing tests that old shared workouts are cleared or that non-sharing members stay off Training progress
what: The year-of-workouts test checks the share, its limits, who may read it, and that turning sharing off or leaving deletes it. No test checks that a member who shares nothing new for 90 days drops off, that a member who never shared is not listed, or that sharing again after turning it off sends the year afresh.
expected: A test ages a share past 90 days and checks it is gone, and checks that a never-sharing member is not listed.
fix_line: Add an aged-share case and a never-shared case to the progress tests

title: Nothing tests that a removed trainer loses their member questions and alerts
what: The message tests take the Trainer tick off a person and sign a desk person out, but never remove a trainer from the gym. No test checks that a removed trainer can no longer read their questions, gets no more alerts, or that a member can no longer send a question to them.
expected: A test removes a trainer and checks they list nothing, get no browser alert, and that a new question to them is refused.
fix_line: Add a removed-trainer case to the message recipient test

title: The browser alert run is never checked for phone numbers or for the 8-day summary limit
what: The browser alert test checks who gets each alert, the summary count and the 6-hour limit for urgent alerts. It never checks that a push body carries no member phone number, and never ages a waiting summary alert past 8 days to see it marked late. Single alert kinds check their own words elsewhere, but the push run as a whole has no such guard.
expected: The push test asserts no 10-digit number in any push body, and that a summary alert older than 8 days is marked late and never sent.
fix_line: Add a no-phone-number check and an 8-day summary case to the browser alert test

title: Phone sign-in is never tested after a change to the person's plan, pass or Trainer tick
what: The phone sign-in tests use people whose state is fixed at the start. None renews an ended plan, removes a pass, or ticks or unticks a trainer and searches again, so a stale answer after such a change would not be caught.
expected: A test changes the plan, pass or tick and checks the next search shows the new state.
fix_line: Add before-and-after cases to the phone sign-in test
